# 1.38.0-beta.2

Improvements and fixes, section B.

- The button that scrolls to the end of the chat keeps its arrow and shows a thin accent outline while work is in progress.
- Download sources settings now let you change or disable the maximum file size. Turning the limit off keeps your chosen size for later, and the settings travel with data exports and imports.
- The Run button in PowerShell code blocks now executes the unchanged code on this computer through the existing tool permissions and confirmations. You can stop the command and copy its output from the result dialog. Batch and CMD blocks keep their existing behavior.
